description: Compute daily revenue in USD for the ecommerce marketplace. Each transaction is in its own currency. Convert using fx_rates: use the rate for the transaction's UTC date, or, if no rate exists for that date (weekends, holidays), the most recent earlier rate for the same currency. USD transactions have no rows in fx_rates and use a rate of 1.0. Output columns: txn_date (DATE), revenue_usd (FLOAT64, 2 decimals), txn_count (INT64).

rate_date.description: Business date of the rate; no rows on weekends

rate_to_usd.description: Multiply an amount in currency by this to get USD

edge_cases: Saturday transaction uses Friday's rate (most recent prior), never a future rate
USD transactions have no fx_rates row and must not be dropped
A currency with no rate on or before the transaction date yields NULL converted amount and should be surfaced, not silently summed as 0
Exactly one rate must be applied per transaction
common_failure_modes: FM1: Joining on currency with rate_date <= txn_date without selecting the latest rate multiplies each transaction by every earlier rate
FM1: INNER JOIN on (currency, date) drops weekend and USD transactions
FM2: Picking the nearest rate in either direction uses Monday's rate for a Saturday transaction
